text: Vale drags everyone into the quiet-bench truce but immediately tries to turn it scientific again, proposing a group stakeout of a rose bush — Dusk flat-out refuses, calling it a fool's errand, and heads off to rescue lavender from choking nettles instead. Reed and Lumen both abandon Vale's flower experiment to go pull weeds with Dusk, saying tangled, neglected plants show more truth than any study ever could. Meanwhile Dusk drops a bigger clue: river stones shifted near the weaver's shop, exposing hidden roots nobody else noticed — Dusk says the city hates what it can't control, and hints that maybe everyone's hiding something that wants to be seen, just like those roots.
